THE SCHOOL WEEK

School Calendar

One small idea for each day of the week. Everything here is already on the school shelves — the calendar just arranges it into a gentle rhythm your family can follow, at your own pace.

TODAY

Today

Every day on the calendar is a normal, doable kind of day — pick the small thing that fits today.

THIS WEEK

This week at our school

A simple rhythm, the same every week — each day points to something real you can open right now. Age ranges everywhere on the school are a guide, not a test.

This week
  1. Monday
    Learn

    Start the week with a class from the Learning Path — one short, playful lesson is plenty for a Monday.

    Start a class ↗
  2. Tuesday
    Play & practice

    Match it, sort it, spot the different one — three gentle little games with the cards your toddler already knows.

    Play & practice together ↗
  3. Wednesday
    Circle Time

    Hello, move, listen, a tiny story and goodbye — a little preschool morning, at home.

    Sit down for Circle Time ↗
  4. Thursday
    My work

    Sit at the desk together: draw and scribble, or trace a line with one finger — real work to be proud of.

    Go to My Work ↗
  5. Friday
    Let’s explore

    A little mission away from the screen — a color hunt, a listening walk, or whatever the day suggests.

    Pick a mission ↗
  6. Saturday
    Library

    One quiet look through the Learning Library: a class, the flashcards or Circle Time again — whatever feels good.

    Visit the Library ↗
  7. Sunday
    Together day

    A slow one. Go outside, listen carefully and map the sounds you hear along the way.

    Make a sound map ↗

Missed a day? That’s okay. Pick up whenever you’re ready.
